summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its Q1 2026 trading update, including a new $500 million share buyback program alongside a reaffirmation of full-year guidance. The company reported Q1 revenue of $1,501 million (up 3.1% underlying) and noted the buyback reflects confidence in performance, strong balance sheet, and free cash flow generation. The buyback is a capital return to shareholders, with no price per share, premium, or expiry specified. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves as the equivalent of a US earnings press release. Watch for execution pace and impact on share price near term.
